answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 152396 Country: India Title: While praying salah the Safs are arrange as imam, men, children and then women saf. Is saf arranged only in this manner? Question: While praying salah the Safs are arrange as imam, men, children and then women saf. Is saf arranged only in this manner? Answer ID: 152396 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1099/1116/B=11/1438) Yes, the Hadith speaks about setting the rows in the same order. But it is also mentioned in Hadith that it is far better for women to offer salah in their home. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
